seo.meta_description: Explore the meaning, origin, and religious significance of the Hindu name Sankari.
seo.description_paragraph: Sankari is a Hindu female name that symbolizes fortune, prosperity, and abundance. Derived from the Sanskrit language, Sankari is often associated with the goddess Lakshmi, the deity of wealth and prosperity in Hinduism. In Hindu mythology, Sankari is also linked to the elephant-headed god Ganesha, who is believed to bring good fortune and remove obstacles.
